facts.fact: 中情局全力投入 1990 年代的管理咨询热潮。
facts.anchor: CIA plunged into the 1990s management consulting craze deeply and with both feet.

facts.fact: 新千年之初，中情局一名精明的操作者看准了：把管理咨询术语引进办公场所，日后可在自我评估里炫耀。
facts.anchor: some sharp operator at CIA recognized sometime early in the new millennium

facts.fact: 此人被提拔到远超能力的高度，恰好与七楼相配。
facts.anchor: He got elevated so far beyond the level of his abilities that he fit in perfectly up there on the Seventh Floor.

facts.fact: 中情局高层所忧虑的员工规模为 999,000 人，不含食堂工作人员。
facts.anchor: some nine hundred ninety-nine thousand souls, not counting the folks who labored down in the cafeteria

facts.fact: 一周领导力培训花掉美国政府 3,662,768.67 美元，甜甜圈算在内。
facts.anchor: all for a draw on the U.S. government teat of just $3,662,768.67, donuts included

facts.fact: 训练营同学给 Shemp 起绰号“Samsonite”，因为得一路把他拖到毕业。
